entries.title: Ask HN: A way to adblock “we're using cookies” popups?
entries.author: rayalez
entries.current_title: Ask HN: A way to adblock “we're using cookies” popups?
entries.excerpt: Whatever the intent of the GDPR was, the practical result is that now I have to click away the annoying "we're using cookies" popup on every website. Is there any way to do this automatically? If there isn't - there should be. Maybe people should use some special tag for them, so that it would be easy for users to block them on all the websites, if they want to.
entries.guide_zh: 网页到处弹出 Cookie 同意框，有什么拦截工具能减少反复点击？

entries.title: Ask HN: Which tools have made you a much better programmer?
entries.author: karamazov
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Which tools have made you a much better programmer?
entries.excerpt: Getting better at coding is usually a long, slow process of study and practice. However, sometimes I run into something that's easy to understand and, once I'm using it, feels like I've leveled up. A few personal examples are: * version control - specifically, reading up on git and understanding the more complex commands * debuggers * flame graphs for performance debugging * good code search What have you added to your workflow that's made you much more productive?
entries.guide_zh: 哪些工具让你的编程能力明显提升，带来的改变超过了普通的效率优化？
